raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase lean muscle mass with plant-based protein target 150g/day"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper/Push Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Glutes Focus":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull/Back Focus":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper/Push + Volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull/Back + Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          abs_circuit 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Hypertrophy Upper/Push":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower/Quads/Glutes":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull/Back + Biceps":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push/Volume":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower/ Hamstring Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calves_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull/Back + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          abs_circuit 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper/Push Intensity + Volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower/Glutes/Hamstrings":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull/Back + Arms":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Push/Strength Mix":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower/Total":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calves_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull/Back + Core":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x45 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          abs_circuit 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Hypertrophy/Push":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower/Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull/Back + Arms":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds

NUTRITION_PLAN
  DIET_TYPE "vegan"
  PROTEIN_TARGET_PER_DAY 150g
  PROTEIN_SOURCE_CATEGORIES "plant-based protein sources only"
  NOTES "Ensure complete amino acid profile; consider soy, pulses, quinoa, seeds, nuts, and fortified products; supplement with vitamin B12, D, iodine, and omega-3 as needed. Hydration: 2.2–3.0L/day baseline; adjust for training. Consider protein distribution: 0.3g/kg per meal across 4–6 meals."
